name: QualiaLight
description: QualiaLight is a plugin allowing to command real-life DMX fixtures with CV signals. QualiaLight is part of the QualiaTouch project. QualiaTouch is about giving the machine perception and action capabilities with the outside world.
author: Qualia Touch
